content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIEST Shibpur Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur (IIEST Shibpur), located in West Bengal, for a project under the civil engineering department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in IIEST Shibpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The position available is Site Engineer, which is a temporary role meant for a specific consultancy project at the institute under the supervision of the department faculty.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Site Engineer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Site Engineer position, offering candidates a temporary employment opportunity in the research and development infrastructure sector.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Site Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE in Civil Engineering or a Diploma in Civil Engineering along with relevant professional experience in the civil engineering domain to be considered eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range provided for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 30,000 depending on the qualification, with Diploma holders getting Rs. 25,000/- and BE degree holders or experienced diploma holders getting Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of selection for IIEST Shibpur Site Engineer?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a walk-in-interview or an online mode interview conducted after thoroughly scrutinizing the bio-data and qualifications submitted by the aspiring candidates.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is officially scheduled to take place on 6 October 2026. Candidates are requested to check the reporting time and venue details prior to attending.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring two hard copies of their bio-data for submission, along with original or e-copies of mark sheets, certificates, ID proof, and self-attested photocopies of all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any prior submission required before the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates are advised to send a soft copy of their bio-data in advance through e-mail to Prof. Ambarish Ghosh at the designated email address provided in the official notice.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the institute located?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur is situated in Howrah, West Bengal, bearing the pincode 711103, where the interview proceedings will take place.
